vocabulary.meaning_en: a feeling of not being sure
vocabulary.example: I have a few doubts about the plan.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the state of not knowing what will happen
vocabulary.example: There is a lot of uncertainty at work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not certain; people may have different opinions about it
vocabulary.example: Whether it's a good idea is debatable.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very probably not going to happen
vocabulary.example: It's highly unlikely that he forgot.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a holiday at home or in your own country
vocabulary.example: This year we're having a staycation.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a story that people tell which may not be true
vocabulary.example: I heard a rumour about extra holidays.

vocabulary.meaning_en: be unable to decide between two choices
vocabulary.note_ar: يقال أيضًا be of two minds
vocabulary.example: I'm in two minds about changing schools.
Our holiday plans are still up in the air.

vocabulary.meaning_en: wait until the next day before deciding
vocabulary.example: Let me sleep on it and tell you tomorrow.
Let's look at the pros and cons.
We don't want to postpone the launch again.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an opinion you give after careful thought
vocabulary.example: I'll give you my considered opinion next week.

fine_lines.title: How sure are you? A scale of doubt
fine_lines.explanation_ar: I'm not 100% sure but ... = أنا شبه متأكد. I don't know about that / I'm really not sure = لا أعرف ولديّ شك. I find that highly unlikely = أكاد أكون متأكدًا أنه لن يحدث.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "I'm not 100% sure, but..." = I'm almost sure. "I don't know about that / I'm really not sure" = I have doubts. "I find that highly unlikely" = I'm almost sure it won't happen.

examples.sentence: I'm not 100% sure, but I think I saw Michael in town.
Two extra days off? I find that highly unlikely.

fine_lines.title: in two minds vs up in the air
fine_lines.explanation_ar: in two minds تصف الشخص المتردد بين خيارين. up in the air تصف الموقف أو الخطة غير المحسومة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "In two minds" describes a person who can't decide. "Up in the air" describes a situation or plan that isn't decided.

examples.sentence: I'm in two minds about selling my car.
Things are up in the air at work right now.

expressions.meaning_en: Says you are not sure or have doubts.
expressions.example: Will you be here on Friday? — I don't know about that.

expressions.phrase: I'm really not sure about that.
expressions.example: Sell the old furniture? I'm really not sure about that.
I'm not 100% sure, but I think the shop closes at six.

expressions.meaning_en: Says people may disagree about it.
expressions.example: Staycations are better? Well, that's debatable.

expressions.meaning_en: Says you are almost sure it won't happen.
expressions.example: He came to the city without telling us? I find that highly unlikely.

expressions.meaning_en: Says you are not fully sure about a plan.
expressions.example: I have a few doubts about that hotel. The reviews aren't great.

expressions.phrase: Are you certain that would work?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل أنت متأكد أن ذلك سينجح؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asks someone to confirm their idea.
expressions.example: Use only social media? Are you certain that would work?

expressions.phrase: I'm in two minds about this.
expressions.meaning_en: Says you can't decide between two options.
expressions.example: I'm in two minds about moving to a new school.

expressions.phrase: Things are up in the air at the moment.
expressions.meaning_ar: الأمور غير محسومة في الوقت الحالي.
expressions.example: There's a big review at work, so things are up in the air at the moment.

expressions.phrase: I want to sleep on it.
expressions.meaning_ar: أريد أن أفكر فيه حتى الغد.
expressions.example: Don't push me. I want to sleep on it.

expressions.meaning_en: Asks for time to think about or deal with something.
expressions.example: Just leave it with me, and I'll give you an answer tomorrow.

expressions.phrase: We'll have to wait and see.
expressions.example: Which university will she go to? We'll have to wait and see.

expressions.meaning_en: Says you think something is quite possible.
expressions.example: I wouldn't be surprised if we got an announcement soon.

grammar.title: Adding emphasis with "really"
grammar.explanation_ar: نضع really قبل الصفة أو بعد الفعل المساعد لتقوية المعنى: I'm not sure ← I'm really not sure.
grammar.explanation_en: Put "really" before an adjective or after the auxiliary verb to make it stronger: I'm not sure → I'm really not sure.
examples: I'm really not sure about that.

grammar.title: I find it + adjective + that ...
grammar.explanation_ar: تركيب لإبداء الرأي: I find it hard / unlikely / strange that ... أي: أرى أنه ...
grammar.explanation_en: A structure to give your opinion: I find it hard / unlikely / strange that ...
examples: I find it highly unlikely that he forgot.
I find it strange that nobody called.

questions.question: Which shows you are ALMOST sure?
choices: I'm not 100% sure, but I think so.
Things are up in the air.
questions.explanation_ar: I'm not 100% sure but ... تعني شبه متأكد.
questions.explanation_en: "I'm not 100% sure, but..." means almost sure.

questions.question: "I'm in two minds" means:
questions.explanation_ar: in two minds = متردد بين خيارين.

questions.question: "Things are up in the air" means:
questions.explanation_ar: up in the air = غير محسوم.

questions.question: You need time before you decide. You say:
choices: I want to sleep on it.
questions.explanation_ar: sleep on it = تأجيل القرار حتى الغد.

questions.question: "That's debatable" means:
choices: People may have different opinions about it.

questions.question: Which shows you think something will almost certainly NOT happen?
Which word has a silent letter?
"Are you certain that would work?" asks for:
A "staycation" is:
choices: a holiday at home or in your own country
questions.explanation_en: A staycation is a holiday at home.
